verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is a game engine, so a fast edit-run loop is a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence pack never mentions hot reload, live preview, or iteration speed after script changes. The material covers agent/MCP setup, publishing, multiplayer services, and native C++/C# support, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change
